title: Lookup picker in a dialog: dropdown opens into too little space below (last option clipped mid-row) and truncates the account name that tells contacts apart
body: ### Edition ObjectOS Community (self-hosted, this repository's code) ### Version @objectstack 18.5.0 (`objectstack dev`, objectstack-ai/hotcrm main) ### What happened / What you expected In an action dialog with a lookup field, the lookup picker's dropdown opens downward and is squeezed into the space left between the field and the bottom of the dialog/viewport. Seen on HotCRM, zh-CN UI: the meeting dialog's **联系人参会人** (contact attendees) lookup, near the bottom of the dialog. What I saw: 1. Only about 4½ options fit. The last visible option ("Marcus Reed") is cut in half: its name shows, its subtitle row (email, account) is hidden. A first-time user reads this as a rendering bug, not as "scroll for more". The list is scrollable, so no data is lost. 2. Each option's subtitle truncates both secondary fields at once: `邮箱: emily.d@starkmed.example.c…` · `所属客户: Stark Medi…`, `Wayne Enterpri…`, `Acme Corpor…`. The account name is what tells two same-named contacts apart, and it is the part cut off. What I expected: - When the space below the field cannot show a reasonable number of options, the popover flips upward (or the dialog body scrolls so the popover gets its space), as Radix/floating-ui collision handling does. An option row is never shown half-clipped at the popover's edge without a visible scroll cue. - The secondary fields get room to be told apart: e.g. wrap the subtitle onto its own line per field, keep the account name ahead of the email, or show the full value on hover/title. ### Steps 1. `pnpm dev` in objectstack-ai/hotcrm (18.5.0), sign in with a user whose language is zh-CN. 2. Open an action dialog that ends in a contact lookup, e.g. schedule a meeting from an account/opportunity, and open the **联系人参会人** picker with the window at a normal laptop height (~800px). 3. Observe the dropdown: ~4½ rows visible, the last row clipped mid-item, the email and account subtitle both truncated.
